newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares start higher, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares start higher, seen rising.

text.p: ** (0445 GMT) Bombay shares open higher, seen gaining with
start of new account at the National exchange helping
fresh position building ** Benchmark Bombay index up 27.76 points, or 0.66 percent,
at 4,248.78 ** National exchange index gains 19.80 points, or 1.67
percent, to 1,203.15 ** Action seen in cement share ACC and textile
stock Bombay Dyeing goes into no-delivery period
at the National exchange ** No delivery for dividend payments normally gives players
about three weeks to settle deals against the usual
week's time ** A crucial victory for embattled chief minister in Bihar
seen helping sentiment as he unlikely to create problems
for minority ruling coalition of prime minister Inder
